_source: genshin-impact.fandom.com — Genius Invokation TCG Card List. All 194 Event, 284 Equipment and 289 Support card rows were scanned for 'switch'; the entries below are the full set of hits that matter, quoted verbatim.
_note: Card text is quoted, not paraphrased. If a card reads oddly, that is how it is printed. Re-check after a version bump — balance changes hit this game often.
_why: Varesa's Elemental Skill switches her out and her Apex Drive only pays out when she is switched back in. Her deck is a swap deck whether or not it was built as one, so switch cost is her real resource.
_reality: There is no generic swap bonus in this game. Switching is a cost, and most of the card pool makes it cheaper rather than rewarding it. Only seven cards turn a switch into actual value, and the biggest one is Varesa's own Apex Drive. Everything else exists to let her do it more often.

keywords.name: Efficient Switch
keywords.text: A stack makes your next Switch Character cost 1 less Elemental Die.

keywords.name: Agile Switch
keywords.text: The next time you perform "Switch Character": This switch will be considered a Fast Action instead of a Combat Action. (Can stack, no stack limit)
keywords.note: The expensive one. A Fast Action does not end your turn, so the switch is free in tempo, not just dice.

groups.title: The engine — persistent, fires every round
groups.note: These sit in your Support Zone and work without you spending an action on them.

cards.name: Red Feather Fan
cards.text: After you switch characters: Gain 1 stack of Efficient Switch and Agile Switch. (Once per Round)
cards.why: One switch pays for the next, in both currencies at once. Nothing else does both.

cards.name: Liu Su
cards.text: After you switch characters: If the character you switched to does not have Energy, they will gain 1 Energy. (Once per Round)
cards.why: Energy out of a thing you were doing anyway. Varesa swaps every round.

cards.name: Dawn Winery
cards.text: When you perform "Switch Character": Spend 1 less Elemental Die. (Twice per Round)
cards.why: Twice per round, not once. Already in your starter deck — check it is in the 30.

cards.name: Katheryne
cards.text: When you perform "Switch Character": The switch is considered a Fast Action instead of a Combat Action. (Once per Round)
cards.why: Agile Switch for one die, no character slot. Does what Iansan does without costing you a character.

cards.name: "Flower-Feather Clan"
cards.text: After you Discard 2 cards: Your next off-field character gains 1 stack of "The next time this character switches to become your active character, recover 1 Elemental Die of the corresponding color." (Can stack. Triggers 1 stack each time.)
cards.why: Free to play, but needs a discard deck to turn on. Skip unless you build for it.

groups.title: Keyed to Varesa specifically
groups.note: Her free Guardian Vent: Volcano Kablam is a prepared Skill and counts as a Plunging Attack. Both of those words appear on cards.

cards.name: Dyed Tassel
cards.text: After the attached character uses a Charged Attack: Deals +1 DMG. (Once per Round) After the attached character uses a Plunging Attack: Create 1 stack of Efficient Switch. (Once per Round)
cards.why: Volcano Kablam is a Plunging Attack, so every Apex Drive generates her own switch discount. Put it on Varesa.

cards.name: "Collective of Plenty"
cards.text: When your character prepares a Skill: This character gains 3 Workout. After your character switches to become the active character: This character gains 2 Workout. (When Workout stacks reach 3, heal the corresponding character for 1 HP. When Workout stacks reach 5, the corresponding character deals +1 DMG)
cards.why: Apex Drive is a prepare triggered by switching in, so Varesa hits both clauses in one rotation and reaches 5 — heal and +1 DMG from her own loop.

cards.name: Vermillion Hereafter
cards.text: When the character uses a Normal Attack or equips a Talent: Spend 1 less Elemental Die. (Once per Round) After a character is switched to the active character: During this Round, character deals +1 Normal Attack DMG.
cards.why: Her Normal Attack is the thing that builds Nightsoul points, and she is switched in constantly.

cards.name: Plunging Strike
cards.text: Combat Action: Switch to the target character. That character then uses a Normal Attack.
cards.why: Switch plus an attack in one card. Varesa's By the Horns deals +1 when used as a Plunging Attack and gives her a Nightsoul point, and it feeds Dyed Tassel on the way through.

cards.name: Conductor's Top Hat
cards.text: After you switch to the character to which this is attached: Discard the card with the highest original Elemental Dice Cost in your Hand and change 2 Elemental Dice into Omni Element, and spend 1 less Elemental Die the next time the character uses a Skill.
cards.why: Two Omni per switch-in is real dice fixing, but it eats your most expensive card each time.

groups.title: One-shots you already own
groups.note: All three came with the starter deck. Confirm they are actually in your 30 before buying anything above.

cards.name: Changing Shifts
cards.text: The next time you perform "Switch Character": Spend 1 less Elemental Die.

cards.name: Leave It to Me!
cards.text: The next time you perform "Switch Character": The switch will be considered a Fast Action instead of a Combat Action.

cards.name: When the Crane Returned
cards.text: The next time you use a Skill: Switch your next character in to be the active character.
cards.why: Switches for you off a Skill you were using regardless.

groups.title: Locked to you, recorded so you stop re-checking

cards.name: Elemental Resonance: Impetuous Winds
cards.locked: Needs 2 Anemo characters in the deck.
cards.text: The next time you perform "Switch Character": This action will be considered a Fast Action instead of a Combat Action. It will also cost 1 less Elemental Die. The next Swirl Reaction you trigger deals +1 DMG to all opposing characters.

cards.name: Wind and Freedom
cards.locked: Needs 2 Mondstadt characters in the deck.
cards.text: During this turn, after one of your characters uses a Skill: Switch your next character in to be the active character.

cards.name: Falls and Fortune
cards.text: Can only be played when you have at least 8 Elemental Dice remaining and your opponent has not ended their Round: In this Round, both sides must spend 1 extra Elemental Die to switch characters.
cards.why: The counter to everything on this page. A swap deck is a deck with a known weakness — keep a round's worth of damage that does not need a switch.

characters.name: Varesa
characters.text: Skill: Deals 2 Electro DMG, applies Sudden Onrush to self … then switches to the next character. Passive: After Varesa uses a Skill, if she has 2 Nightsoul points, she consumes them and applies Apex Drive. Apex Drive: After Varesa is switched in to be the Active Character: Prepare Skill: Guardian Vent: Volcano Kablam (3 Electro DMG, 0 dice, considered a Plunging Attack).
characters.why: The engine. Her damage exists because she leaves and comes back.

characters.name: Kuki Shinobu
characters.text: Grass Ring of Sanctification — After you switch characters: Deal 1 Electro DMG, heal the character on your team that has taken the most damage for 1 HP. (Once per Round) Usage(s): 3
characters.why: The best payoff card in the game for this deck: Varesa's own rotation triggers it, so the healing costs you nothing extra.

characters.name: Keqing
characters.text: Lightning Stiletto — Combat Action: Switch your Keqing in to be your active character and immediately use Stellar Restoration once. This instance will grant Keqing Electro Infusion without creating another Lightning Stiletto.
characters.why: A switch-in and an attack on one card. Varesa swaps out, Keqing swaps in swinging.

characters.name: Iansan
characters.text: Thunderbolt Rush creates 1 stack of Agile Switch. Burst creates Kinetic Energy Scale: When your character deals DMG: Deal +2 DMG for this instance. Usage(s): 2
characters.why: A character-slot version of Katheryne, plus a damage buff. Only worth it if you want the slot spent on switching.

characters.name: Fischl
characters.text: Phantasmal Nocturne — Fast Action: Equip this to your Fischl. Summon Oz. While Oz is on the field, your Electro-Related Reactions deal +1 DMG. (3 times per Round)
characters.why: No Match Invitation Letter, and the Talent has no active-character clause — the only Electro card that contributes without ever being switched to.

caveats: Mastery Talisman: Airborne Reinforcements and Mastery Talisman: Cycle Charge read perfectly for Varesa — Fast Action switches plus +2 DMG on Plunging Attacks — but they cost 0 and are listed beside Ley Line Disorder entries, which are stage modifiers. They are probably not deck-buildable. Unconfirmed; do not go hunting for them on this page's say-so.

Yae Miko and Kujou Sara are the two best off-field Electro cards and both are Inazuma. Inazuma characters cannot be invited until A Guest From Liyue, or Radiant Sakura in Raiden's story quest. Inazuma exploration on this account is 0%.
